instructions_to_main_agent: Focus purely on building a dark, ultra-sleek 24/7 radio experience with a YouTube channel layout structure.

Ensure all interactive buttons, links, inputs, and track cards have strict 'data-testid' attributes (e.g. data-testid='radio-play-button', data-testid='channel-subscribe-button', data-testid='track-card-01').
The persistent PlayerBar component MUST NOT break audio state when navigating between tabs (Live, Piese, Despre).
Do NOT use light backgrounds, transparent header dropdowns without backdrop blur, or generic AI slop artwork.
Admin section (/admin) must ONLY be an upload form for music audio and cover artwork, plus track list management.
Use JavaScript (.js and .jsx) files in src/ for component development.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Do not make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
